verdict.rationale: Washington ESD offers online employer services through EAMS and eServices, where quarterly reports and account changes are handled. A public agency with an online filing portal could plausibly offer a programmatic interface, so the API-parity axis applies. The evidence shows no API at all: every OpenAPI and Swagger probe returned 404, and the transactional portal sits entirely behind a SecureAccess Washington login. Several tasks, such as amended reports by email, mail or fax and paper forms, are not even online.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
